question:
In the following question, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6e298f3fb56eb8cfb50173230540e292b0f96b7d4e2699d99799a6ec5b08340.png]
solution:
The logic follows here is :

The inner darkened pentagon moves from one corner to the next corner and the inner symbol rotates 180 degrees in every step. 

So, the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cb7a0bc498884b064b098d12d070c35db01848c8f2d732fead80e1872ff0507.png] 

Thus, the figure in option(2) will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option(2)".
